items.q: How long does the full cat. B driving course take?
items.a: Typically 6–10 weeks, depending on the student's availability. We also offer an express mode to shorten the time.

items.q: Can I drive the same car at the exam?
items.a: Yes! Our fleet consists of cars identical to WORD Poznań exam vehicles – you learn where you take the exam.
We offer 0% instalments – first payment is 1 000 PLN upon enrolment. Each subsequent instalment is agreed individually after completing every 10 hours of driving.

items.q: What is the minimum age to start the course?
items.a: You can start the course 3 months before your 18th birthday. Students aged 16 years and 9 months can start with parental or guardian consent.

items.q: Do you offer an automatic gearbox course?
items.a: Yes! We have an automatic gearbox car – we provide it for interested students. The automatic course costs 4 800 PLN.

teenModal.title: Are you 16 years and 9 months old?
teenModal.desc:
You don't have to wait until you're 18! You can start learning to drive at the age of 16 years and 9 months — you just need parental or guardian consent.

Call us and arrange the start of your course before your 18th birthday.

somModal.title: Child protection standards
somModal.p1: The eMKA Driving School in Poznań has implemented Child Protection Standards in accordance with the Act of 28 July 2023 amending the Family and Guardianship Code and other acts (the so-called Kamilek Act).
items: Verification of employees and instructors for criminal records
Procedures for responding to signs of harm to minors
Rules for safe contact with underage students
Designation of a person responsible for child protection at the school
somModal.p3: The full standards document is available at our office and can be sent by email on request. For questions:
